scripts.errorHandlers:
from typing import Any, Union, Dict from django.contrib import messages from django.http import (HttpRequest, HttpResponseRedirect, HttpResponsePermanentRedirect, JsonResponse) from django.shortcuts import redirect from ....configs.messages_templates import get_exception_class_message from .http import get_redirect_url import logging error_logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) def default_permission_denial(request: HttpRequest, err: Any, ref: str = '#UNDEFINED_REFERENCE', logger: logging.Logger = error_logger, redirect_path: str = '/', auto_redirect: bool = True, json: Dict[str, Any] = None) -> Union[HttpResponseRedirect, HttpResponsePermanentRedirect, JsonResponse, None]: from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied logger.error(f'{ref} denied permission: {err}') messages.error(request, get_exception_class_message(PermissionDenied, ref)) if json: return JsonResponse({'error': 'Permission denied.'}, status=401) return redirect(get_redirect_url(request, redirect_path)) if auto_redirect else None
def default_undefined_exception(request: HttpRequest, err: Any, ref: str = '#UNDEFINED_REFERENCE', logger: logging.Logger = error_logger, redirect_path: str = '/', auto_redirect: bool = True, json: Dict[str, Any] = None, status: int = 500) -> Union[HttpResponseRedirect, HttpResponsePermanentRedirect, JsonResponse, None]: logger.error(f'{ref} raised an undefined error: {err}') messages.error(request, f'An undefined error was raised: {err}') if json: return JsonResponse({'error': json}, status=status) return redirect(get_redirect_url(request, redirect_path)) if auto_redirect else None

fields.summary: Refactor the list of fields bellow considering if it fits the demands of arguments in the switch bellow for its case

AllCases.constants: - default if possible to define ** Except for DateField, DateTimeField, DurationField, FileField, GenericIPAddressField and URLField
AllCases.conditionals: - help_text if the field name is not obvious - verbose_name if the field name is not descriptive enough - null=True if an seemingly optional field to be passed to the database - blank=True if an seemingly optional field to be passed to the clientside as a form - db_index if there are more than 5 fields in the model

case.name: DecimalField
case.conditionals: - validators if is possible to define them according to the field's local name

case.name: CharField
case.constant: - max_length, following the expected according to the field local name

case.name: DateTimeField
case.constant: - defaulted to auto_now_add=True for creation fields, auto_now=True for update fields

case.name: FileField
case.constant: - storage defaulted as default_storage from django

case.name: GenericIPAddressField
case.constant: - if protocol argument is explicit as not set to both, then remove it so it defaults to both - unpack_ipv4 set to True

case.name: JSONField
case.conditionals: - encoder, if a logic is noticeable for that (as a lambda function) - decoder, if a logic is noticeable for that (as a lambda function)

case.name: URLField
case.conditionals: - validators if there is a clear pattern

models.general: - Convert any camelCase variant into snake_case, except for class names

suggestions.comments: - Do not include descriptive comments, ONLY those pointing that logic should be added or refactored, with commented out suggestions
suggestions.punctuation: - Always include trailing semicolons; - Do not include new lines for readibility only;
suggestions.statements: - For pairs of if/else blocks that lead to single statements in both cases, replace by ternary operators;
suggestions.imports: - Imports and exports should be sorted alphabetically in all depths

python.importing: - Never use importlib, unless strictly demanded

instructions.classes: - Don't convert a class into a function even if it only has one method without instance properties (essentially static); instead, convert it to a class with a def index as a @classmethod (or a @statimethod if is a really simple procedure with no calls for authentication or from the for error_handlers.py);

models.notes: - One block FOR EACH model - Every model should implement DefaultTimed (which already implements models.Model, so omit that one) and have the created_by def_user_creation() call - Since DefaultTimed already defines created_at and updated_at, these fields do not need to be directly defined - for every model that follow the pattern of (primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False), replace by (**uuid_def_primary()) - DO NOT add semicolons - If an argumentation user blank=True, null=True (or the inverse), then import VOID from .._helpers.fields and spread it in the arguments
models.IMPORTANT: - DO NOT CHANGE FIELD NAMES NOR REMOVE ANY FIELD - REPLACE models.CharField(max_length=255) by def_char_field() -and models.CharField(max_length=255, nullable=True, blank=True) by def_char_field(voidable=True)
